scope: Real private-room.js, lazy demand/close/profileChunks, and app.save with localStorage quota exception; minimal DOM and effects stubs. No browser, product edits, actual media capture or billing.

results.name: connecting rejects messages/gifts/preview and repeated entry keeps one connection
cancelled connection cannot reopen via stale callback and cleans all resources
closing before data finishes cancels pending room navigation
connected session has two opener messages and one clock with no duplicate room
preview leaves all persisted state and session spending unchanged
duplicate gift action debits once and commits one matched global/session gift
insufficient balance opens topup without deduction/history/effect
real save quota failure rolls back every persisted field and session transaction
retry after failed gift save commits exactly once
invalid gift quantities and mismatched gift IDs cannot spend
topup save failure rolls back and successful repeated claim credits only once
finish saves one call, freezes elapsed time and cancels replies/timer/effect
ended session rejects text, gifts, preview and credit claims
return to lobby clears session/observer and preserves scroll
failed call-record save exposes retry and retry stores only one call
external overlay replacement saves once and removes every old resource
older effect callback cannot clear latest effect running state
blocked host cannot start a connection or alter financial state
